issue_title: [Refactor] _ensure_parent_directory 中 exist_ok=False 与前置检查存在冗余逻辑

summary.problem: The _ensure_parent_directory function had a TOCTOU (Time-Of-Check-To-Time-Of-Use) race condition. It checked if parent.exists() and then called mkdir with exist_ok=False. If another process created the directory between the check and mkdir, the call would fail with FileExistsError.
summary.solution: Changed exist_ok=False to exist_ok=True in the mkdir call. This allows the function to succeed even if the directory was created by another process between the check and the mkdir call.

risks.description: Minimal risk. The change only affects the handling of an edge case (directory already exists). The pre-validation loop still checks for file-as-directory conflicts before attempting to create directories.
mitigations: All existing tests pass including test_cli_succeeds_for_normal_nested_paths and test_issue_1894_security_mkdir_fix tests
New test specifically covers the TOCTOU race condition
